settings.heading: THE VALUE
settings.text:
• Unrestricted Access: The Gift Card is a privileged key to the entire Adults Only archive, valid across all collections and future drops.
  • No Expiration: The value is timeless. This card holds no expiry date and maintains its full value indefinitely.
  • Final Sale Status: Gift Cards are non-refundable and cannot be redeemed for cash. Treat this acquisition as a final, deliberate indulgence.

settings.heading: DIGITAL DISCRETION
settings.text:
• Confidential Delivery: The card is delivered instantly and discreetly via email to the recipient's inbox. No physical paper trail will be generated.
  • Privacy Assured: All sender and recipient information is kept strictly confidential. We promise an uninterrupted, private transaction experience.
  • How to Redeem: The unique code can be applied at the final checkout stage. Use it to acquire your own slice of confident rebellion.
